paragraphs: The Z4 sDrive30i has been a mainstay of the Z4 diesel range since 2012, spanning two generations under one badge. Early E85/E86 models from 2012 to 2015 use the N47, a 2.0-litre diesel that's part of a family known for a specific timing chain issue. From late 2015 onwards, across both the E85/E86 and later the E89, the Z4 sDrive30i switched to the B47, a newer, significantly more reliable unit that doesn't share the N47's timing chain concerns. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the components and the known wear pattern differ - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The Z4 sDrive30i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre diesel fitted to the early E85/E86 Z4 sDrive30i. Known for timing chain failure due to chain guide wear - see the callout above. We replace timing chains, guides, and tensioners as standard on every N47 rebuild.
The later 2.0-litre diesel, fitted from 2015 onwards. A different design from the N47 that is significantly more reliable and doesn't share its predecessor's timing chain issue.

compatibility.intro: Because the Z4 sDrive30i spans two distinct engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement - or assuming an N47 part will work on a B47 car - risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (N47 or B47) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Z4 sDrive30i quote - it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
